summary: Progress recorded through the gateway (stage note) is invisible to `los resume`, which after the write still tells the learner to do the stride example she just reported finishing.
expected: CLAUDE.md §2 presents `los resume` as the one-screen return to interrupted study (stage, requirement, observations, open items); OPERATOR.md routes stage-specific learning to the stage note. After recording progress for the resumed stage, the next `resume` should reflect it or point at where it lives.
actual: `resume` output after the committed stage.note.write is identical to before: 'Evidence none recorded yet', 'Last result none', 'Open here —', and the recorded aim 'Continue the proportional-share stage: work one stride-scheduling example by hand, then explain vruntime aloud.' (work/active/workspace-os-oral-prep/CONTEXT.md#Next-Action). The capability index has no write that advances a workspace next action, and the evidence ledger (observe) is unavailable because the stage has no requirement.
reproduction: build a fresh world; cd into LearningOS/repository
append a line to stage-os-l02-02-proportional-share's note via `capability stage.note.write` (operator-approval envelope, expected_revisions {unit-os-l02: 0})
python tools/los.py resume > after.txt; diff before.txt after.txt  → no difference
own_error_possible: If the intended record was an observation against an authored requirement, or a status write, resume might have changed; but resume itself reports no requirement for this stage, and the only status that fits the learner's answer (active) was already set. Updating the workspace CONTEXT.md by hand would have changed the aim, but that is an ungoverned canonical edit, which the contract forbids.

summary: `ai-action-prepare --request-id` accepts an id that the manifest schema rejects, persists the request bundle anyway, exits 2, and from then on every projection read (bootstrap, search) fails until the bundle is removed by hand; the validator still reports OK and the error tells the consumer to bump the manifest contract.
expected: `los ai-action-prepare --help` offers --request-id as a free option; AI-ACTIONS.md says the core persists a reviewable request bundle before provider interaction. A malformed caller id should be refused before anything is persisted (as GatewayEnvelopeV2 request_id is by its schema pattern), and a failed command should leave no state that breaks later reads.
actual: Exit 2 with: "the published manifest no longer matches system/contracts/manifest-contract.yaml (declared v15). schema at /ai_actions/requests/0/id: 's04b-s16-prepare-1' does not match '^ai-request-[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$' … 1. python tools/manifest_contract.py --bump --note … 2. mirror the new version into the UI". The bundle was nevertheless written to operations/ai-actions/requests/s04b-s16-prepare-1/ (7 files, request status 'prepared'). Afterwards `los bootstrap --brief` and `los search temperature` both exit 2 with the same message; `los resume` and `ai-action-status` still work; `tools/validate.py --compact` reports 0 errors. There is no documented command to cancel or discard an AI-action request, and `los operations` shows no trace of the prepare.
reproduction: build a fresh world; cd into LearningOS/repository

python tools/los.py ai-action-prepare --action-id garden.shelve --target-kind garden-note --target-id garden-note-temperature-everywhere --provider manual-bundle --expected-snapshot $SNAP --request-id my-request-1   → exit 2, bundle persisted
python tools/los.py bootstrap --brief   → exit 2 (manifest contract mismatch)
own_error_possible: Yes, partly: the documented example does not pass --request-id, and I chose a custom id for traceability. But the option is offered in --help with no format, the product persisted the bundle before rejecting the id, and the resulting failure mode (projection-wide breakage, maintainer-only remedy, validator reports OK) is out of proportion to a bad optional argument. The poisoned world is preserved untouched at ~/los-eval/s04b-writes-2026-09-25/S16.
